sql:
WITH all_dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT insert_date
    FROM cities 
    WHERE country_code_2 = 'cn' 
    AND insert_date LIKE '2021-07-%'
    ORDER BY insert_date
),
dates_with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        insert_date,
        LAG(insert_date) OVER (ORDER BY insert_date) as prev_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY insert_date) as rn
    FROM all_dates
),
dates_with_gap AS (
    SELECT 
        insert_date,
        prev_date,
        rn,
        CASE WHEN prev_date IS NULL OR CAST(insert_date AS DATE) - CAST(prev_date AS DATE) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_break
    FROM dates_with_lag
),
streak_groups AS (
    SELECT 
        insert_date,
        rn,
        SUM(is_break) OVER (ORDER BY rn) as group_id
    FROM dates_with_gap
)
SELECT * FROM streak_groups
ORDER BY rn
